Problem was, over the course of about 2 years, I grew increasingly frustrated with the people I was playing with. There was the guy with ADD who didn't want to hear any rules. Then there was the person who wanted to hear ALL the rules before we started, not that they were capable of remembering them, and then accused me of cheating if I left any out. Then there was the person who combined both those contradicting traits into a single human being who's just miserable to play with no matter what. I'm no saint either. As much as I've complained, I'm sure they have an equal volume of complaints about me.

After 2 years of having my love for board game slowly eroded, I just went back to single player games. It's so much easier not having to deal with people.
